verdict.rationale: Kick documents first-party MCP connectors (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, custom tools) and a CLI that let an AI agent query live transactions, generate reports, and reason over ledger data with your approval, plus a Google Sheets AI integration for live report data — directly enabling natural-language questions like 'can we afford X' grounded in live ledger data pulled via API/MCP. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of an actual 'can we afford X' query working end-to-end, and a public REST/OpenAPI spec (probe found only 404s) confirming a traditional API alongside MCP.
